title: SANER: ANNOTATION-FREE SOCIETAL ATTRIBUTE NEUTRALIZER FOR DEBIASING CLIP

bias_targets.methodology: Measured using the MaxSkew metric to quantify demographic disparities in text-to-image retrieval across neutral queries (adjectives, occupations, activities). It is also evaluated in text-to-image generation using the Statistical Parity (SP) metric to measure group disparity and accuracy to measure attribute retention.
Measured using the MaxSkew metric to quantify the demographic disparity in the top-k retrieved images for attribute-neutral queries during a text-to-image retrieval task.
